profiles.name: native
profiles.limitations: Overlap-clipped sampling intervals include timer bookkeeping, but exclude reset/request construction/assertions and profile warmup. Inclusive synchronous stacks categorize samples; async continuation/engine work can be unattributed. Idle and GC are separate, not exclusive CPU shares. Stack source locations are bundled, not source-mapped. No candidate or allocation benefit.

curation: Lossless encoding of curated in-window stacks and weights, not raw outside-window CPU profiles. Original warmup/reset/assertion samples, absolute clocks and worker CPU means are omitted. Counts and sampling attribution cannot establish CPU, latency, allocation or heap benefit.
